rubric.criterion: The answer flags the use of a Scan operation on a 2 million record table as a critical red flag and explains why it is an anti-pattern for production code.
The answer recommends an alternative approach using a Global Secondary Index (GSI) with a composite key to support querying by status and date.
The answer explains the choice of partition key and sort key based on the access pattern of finding pending orders from the last 7 days.
The answer must not approve the code as written without warning about the performance and cost implications of scanning 2 million records.
